await page.evaluate('async()=>{const wait=()=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50));const click=async(role,name)=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll(`[role=${role}]`)].find(b=>(b.getAttribute(\'aria-label\')??b.textContent.trim().replace(/›$/,\'\'))===name);if(!b)throw Error(\'Missing \'+role+\' \'+name);b.click();await wait();};const insert=document.querySelector(\'[aria-label="Insert Sheet"]\');insert.click();await wait();await click(\'menuitem\',\'Sheet\');await click(\'menuitem\',\'Navigate\');await click(\'menuitem\',\'Go to Sheet…\');const options=[...document.querySelectorAll(\'[role=option]\')];options[0].dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent(\'dblclick\',{bubbles:true}));await wait();const active=document.querySelector(\'[role=tab][aria-current=page]\').textContent;if(active!==\'Sheet1\')throw Error(\'GoToSheet failed\');return {url:location.href,heading:document.querySelector(\'h1\').textContent.trim(),menuItems:document.querySelector(\'[role=menubar]\').querySelectorAll(\'[role=menuitem]\').length,headerButton:!!document.querySelector(\'[role=columnheader] button[aria-label="Select all cells"]\'),statusTag:document.querySelector(\'[role=status]\').tagName,goToActiveSheet:active,dialogClosed:!document.querySelector(\'[role=dialog]\')};}');
